title: SQL's NOT IN will produce an unknown value when encountering NULL
summary: In SQLite, if a non-NULL value has no match and the right-hand set contains NULL, NOT IN yields NULL and WHERE discards the row.
applies: SQLite query results and crossing dialect boundaries
detail: For example, the result of 3 NOT IN (1,NULL) is NULL; 1 NOT IN (1,NULL) is false because a match has been found.
boundary: Empty collections have their own rules; a collection containing NULL cannot simply be equated with an empty collection.
relevance: Explanation The filter statement appears to be retaining a record but gets an empty result.
